User.title: User
User.description: System user account with role-based access control.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the user matching Firebase Auth UID.

role.description: Assigned system role (admin has full access, view_only can only view).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was registered.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Catalog item in the inventory. Stock count can only be modified through invoice transactions.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. Units, Kg, Boxes).

minStockThreshold.description: Minimum inventory threshold that triggers low-stock alerts.

currentStock.description: Current quantity in storage, updated strictly through transactions.

location.description: Storage warehouse location or bin identifier.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Formal stock modification record for either receipt (import) or dispatch (export).

type.description: Invoice type: import adds to inventory, export removes from inventory.

referenceNumber.description: External reference number (e.g. PO, DO, or Shipping Bill).

createdByUid.description: UID of the administrator who created and processed the invoice.

createdByEmail.description: Email of the administrator who created the invoice.

totalItems.description: Count of unique product line items in this invoice.

totalQuantity.description: Sum of total unit quantities across all line items.

totalAmount.description: Sum total monetary value of this invoice.

notes.description: Administrative notes or justification for the stock movement.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was completed.

InvoiceItem.title: InvoiceItem
InvoiceItem.description: Itemized line item of an invoice recording exact quantity and stock delta.

unitPrice.description: Unit price at time of transaction.

previousStock.description: Stock count immediately prior to this transaction.

newStock.description: Stock count immediately after this transaction.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable system audit trail log entry.

userId.description: UID of the user executing the action.

entityType.description: Target entity type (e.g. invoice, product, user).

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles and RBAC role assignments.

/products/{productId}.description: Catalog of storage products and current stock balances.

/invoices/{invoiceId}.description: Import and export invoice transactional records.

/invoices/{invoiceId}/items/{itemId}.description: Individual line items for an invoice transaction.
